review.why: Builds, migrates and deploys framework apps (Astro, SvelteKit, React Router, Nuxt, Hono, SPAs) on Cloudflare Workers without Pages templates for new work.
review.summary: Inspect the repository first, preserve the framework choice, then pick a path for a new project, an existing one with Wrangler config or one with none. A table gives the Workers setup and the framework's own agent guidance for each framework. It limits changes to adapter, runtime and deployment configuration, then checks and builds locally before deploying.
strengths: Inspects before changing and keeps the user's framework
Table of per-framework Workers guides and official agent guidance
cautions: Links out to many external guides that change
Mixed CLI guidance: cf for some projects, Wrangler for others
